tools.name: pokedex_list_resources
tools.description: Discover the local Pokédex resource kinds and the operations each supports.

tools.name: pokedex_list
tools.description: List one page of an allowlisted Pokédex resource. Continue only with the opaque nextCursor returned by this tool. Do not finalize until the requested item count is collected or nextCursor is null; always continue an empty page when nextCursor is non-null.

cursor.description: Omit this property entirely for the first page. For a later page, copy the exact nextCursor returned by the immediately preceding call; never invent or edit it.

tools.name: pokedex_search
tools.description: Case- and separator-insensitively search names in one allowlisted local Pokédex resource. Continue only with the opaque nextCursor returned by this tool.

cursor.description: Omit this property entirely for the first page. For a later page, copy the exact nextCursor returned by the immediately preceding call for the same resource and query; never invent or edit it.

tools.name: pokedex_get
tools.description: Read a normalized local reference returned by an earlier Pokédex tool call. URLs and invented references are rejected. If the requested answer needs a fact about a related object, read its returned ref; the relationship name alone is not evidence for that object's fields.
